A Violin of the Francois Caussin School, Vosges, circa 1870, labelled Thibouville-Lamy, Paris, L.O.B. 14 1/8in. (359mm), with a bow in a shaped brown leather case. A good Violin bearing the signed label Galileo Arcellaschi in Como AD 1957, L.O.B. 14in. (355mm). The attractive one-piece back of narrow curl, ribs and scroll of similar figure, table of medium grain, varnish of a transparent golden brown colour. Mint condition.

A Tirolese Violin by Rushworth and Dreaper Liverpool, bearing the Apollo label Style 11 dated 1938, L.O.B. 14in. (355mm). The two-piece back, ribs and scroll of narrow curl, table of even medium grain varnish of a red-brown colour. Post restoration on table, otherwise sound.
